from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import hashlib,json,subprocess

root=Path(r'C:\Users\戴周阳\Documents\New project 8')
branch=root/'reports/research/510300_pandemic_labor_delivery_native_joint_phase_source_v1'
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_202212_native_business_expectation_interpretation_source_v1'
proposal=json.loads((parent/'next_experiment.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
if branch.exists():
    raise RuntimeError('E123来源阶段已有目录，停止重新登记。')
if proposal['status']!='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN':
    raise RuntimeError('原E123提案状态已改变，停止重复登记。')
if proposal['fixed_original_periods']!=['2022-10','2022-11','2022-12','2023-01']:
    raise RuntimeError('固定四阶段不一致，停止登记。')
at=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def receipt(path):
    raw=path.read_bytes()
    return {'path':str(path.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
reuse={
 '2022-12':{
  'raw':receipt(parent/'官方202212解读_首次原始响应.html'),
  'source_receipt':receipt(parent/'官方原页首次收件_E122.json'),
  'url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/jd/sjjd2020/202212/t20221231_1891399.html',
  'prior_experiment':'E122',
  'publication_clock':'UNKNOWN_FORMATION_DATE_NOT_PUBLICATION',
  'native_business_expectation_index':'UNKNOWN_MUST_PRESERVE'
 },
 '2023-01':{
  'raw':receipt(root/'reports/research/510300_equal_production_all_original_month_cause_sources_v1/raw/month_2023-01.html'),
  'source_receipt':receipt(root/'reports/research/510300_equal_production_all_original_month_cause_sources_v1/原GET_2023-01_实际收件.json'),
  'url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896749.html',
  'prior_experiment':'E60',
  'publication_clock':'OWN_ORIGINAL_RAW_PAGE_TO_BE_REVIEWED_NOT_BORROWED',
  'prior_observation_disclosure':'旧来源题名/收件元数据及包含原正文的回执已在登记前读取，含本期生产49.8/订单50.9、各规模人力不足<11%及经营预期55.6/月差+3.7；不可叫新盲数据，不倒推12月。'
 }
}
protocol={
 'study_id':proposal['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E123',
 'registered_at':at,'status':'REGISTERED_SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_RUN',
 'parent_proposal':receipt(parent/'next_experiment.json'),
 'parent_completed_result':receipt(parent/'completed_round.json'),
 'question':proposal['question'],
 'fixed_original_periods':proposal['fixed_original_periods'],
 'source_reuse':reuse,
 'limited_local_presearch_scope':['data/raw/macro文件名','E60已存1月同题原件及收件元数据','E38/E59/E60固定原源结果导航','当前两份宏观配置'],
 'limited_presearch_does_not_establish_global_source_absence':True,
 'fixed_new_queries':{
  '2022-10':'site:stats.gov.cn 赵庆河 解读 2022年10月 中国采购经理指数',
  '2022-11':'site:stats.gov.cn 赵庆河 解读 2022年11月 中国采购经理指数'
 },
 'source_selection':'官方域名中题名精确对应原月份、赵庆河解读采购经理指数的首个查询结果；不按原数量/钟/股市收益选择。1月、12月只复用已存原件。',
 'request_budget':{'new_queries_max':2,'new_first_GETs_max':2,'retries':0,'alternate_carriers':0,'redirects':0,'authenticated_requests':0},
 'quantity_contract':proposal['original_quantity_contract'],
 'clock_contract':proposal['clock_contract'],
 'joint_state_contract':proposal['joint_state_contract'],
 'fixed_quantity_fields':['疫情影响较大企业比重及原变化','劳动力供应不足企业比重及原变化/原规模不等式','制造业生产指数及原变化','制造业新订单指数及原变化','制造业就业指数及原变化','制造业配送时间指数及原变化','制造业购进价格指数及原变化','制造业出厂价格指数及原变化','制造业经营预期原数字及原变化','制造业总体PMI及原变化'],
 'fixed_context_fields':['原疫情与防控阶段描述','原人力与配送约束描述','原需求不足描述','原春节/其他日历因素','原行业/规模异质性','原企业定性预期'],
 'fixed_missing_policy':'每页制造业段只记当期原值/原变化与原不等式；未报告UNKNOWN、未问不等于0；不从翌月倒推、不用其他月份、主数据表或以后表替换本页缺项。',
 'public_clock_qualification':'只准本原页显示的明确发布时间/发表时间及原页可见发布年月日时分或确切发布元数据；成文日期、URL路径、正文关于主PMI发布日期、搜索摘录、首GET/现在收件均不代替。12月E122UNKNOWN保持。',
 'hypothesis_acceptance':'全四期共同状态可支持竞争原因的历史解释；缺量/钟/母体保持，不能把相关共同变化视作严格外生因果或经济收益。',
 'completion_rule':proposal['completion_rule'],
 'financial_budget':proposal['financial_budget'],
 'old_E121_E49_E38_and_all_frozen_financial_rejections_preserved':True,
 'history_selection_disclosure':proposal['history_selection_disclosure']+'；1月旧完整解读含事实已见，本期不重复获取、不声称独立来源增量。',
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E122_ACTUAL_NEW_OFFICIAL_ORIGINAL_DIRECT_CAUSE_SURVEY_QUANTITY_AND_FIXED_ROUTE_VERDICT',
 'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_status':'active','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET'
}
branch.mkdir()
(branch/'raw').mkdir()
for name,obj in [
 ('protocol.json',protocol),
 ('原件登记与旧源复用认领_E123.json',{'registered_at':at,'parent_proposal':protocol['parent_proposal'],'source_reuse':reuse,'new_GET_budget':2,'new_query_budget':2,'existing_source_edits':0}),
 ('运行前git记录_E123.json',{
  'at':at,
  'head':subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip(),
  'tracked_status':subprocess.run(['git','status','--short','--untracked-files=no'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',check=True).stdout,
  'new_existing_source_code_edits':0
 })
]:
    with (branch/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        json.dump(obj,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
        handle.write('\n')
print('E123四阶段来源资格已单独登记；12月和1月复用原件，10月/11月最多2查询及2首次GET。')
print('原未报告UNKNOWN、12月原钟及经营预期UNKNOWN保持；金融/标签/账户/线性/加权/源码预算0。')
print('协议SHA256='+hashlib.sha256((branch/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
